messages:
yara: seeing a periodic NVMe IO/thermal oscillation in ap-south1, GPU attach errors climbing
chet: which hosts/pool?
yara: pool=ephemeral-hot-9, hosts gnode-apse1-401..406. dmesg shows aborts + temp spikes
yara: ```
[ 66778.123] nvme0n1: aborting command status=0x1e
[ 66778.456] nvme0n1: media_error LBA 0x9f00-0x9f80
[ 66778.789] nvme0n1: temperature above threshold: 77C
```
mina: smartctl on 403 shows reallocated sectors and temp=77C
mina: Reallocated_Sector_Ct Raw_Value=5, Temp=77
chet: any recent changes? firmware? janitor? kernel flags?
yara: vendor did a firmware wave last night. janitor scrub cadence increased in same window due to a config push
mina: hypothesis: FW + scrub cadence interacting -> small write bursts and KV cache flush storms -> write amplification and heating
chet: immediate actions: 1) cordon affected hosts from gpu-service 2) throttle janitor for that pool 3) deploy small-write fio on canary before rollback
ops-bot: Incident INC-3792 created: nvme-thermal-oscillation-ap-south1 responders=[yara, chet, mina]
yara: cordoning gnode-401..406 now, will drain pods over next 8-12m
mina: reducing janitor cadence 40m -> 120m for ephemeral-hot-9, enabling backlog alert at 30%
chet: canary plan: apply nvme_trim_aggressive=0 on gnode-404 and run fio: fio --name=smallwrite --rw=randwrite --bs=4k --iodepth=16 --size=6G --numjobs=3
mina: running fio on 404 after drain completes
ops-bot: Vendor contacted for FW diff; asked to pause further rollouts
yara: update: drained 6 hosts, attach failures dropped 13% -> 1.5% in 20m
mina: canary toggle + fio reduced temp p95 by ~12C and write_amp by ~38%
chet: no user-reported corruption so far; kernel I/O errors only
ops-bot: INC-3792 status=mitigated responders=[yara, chet, mina]
yara: follow-ups: postmortem tomorrow 10:30 UTC, include firmware diff, janitor cadence audit, procurement/drive lifecycle ticket
mina: adding dashboard tiles: nvme_temp_p95, write_amp_ratio, attach_fail_rate, janitor_ops_s
chet: thanks team, leaving notes here for the writeup
yara: :thumbsup:
